Definition
[null-eigenvector condition] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0033 1. ch10:10.6\group Tensor maximum principles

A map $\beta $ on symmetric two-tensors satisfies the null-eigenvector condition if $\omega \ge 0$ and $\omega (V,\cdot )=0$ imply $\beta (\omega ,t)(V,V)\ge 0$.
